gbm_population_evidence.quote: Subjects must be pathologically confirmed to have high-grade glioma, defined as WHO (2021) Central Nervous System Tumor Classification grade 3 or 4 gliomas; or primary central nervous system lymphoma (PCNSL).

candidate_evidence.quote: CHT101 is an allogeneic CD70-targeted chimeric antigen receptor Tcell therapy, intended to be administered locally for the treatment of primary malignant brain tumors.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Adult Subjects With Recurrent or Progressive Malignant Primary Brain Tumors

role_evidence.quote: CHT101 is an allogeneic CD70-targeted chimeric antigen receptor Tcell therapy, intended to be administered locally for the treatment of primary malignant brain tumors.

source_quote.quote: Tumor tissue specimens must be CD70-positive as determined by immunohistochemistry (IHC).

coder_notes: Glioblastoma is not named in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arm labels (only in the brief summary), so high_grade_glioma_unspecified. CD70 is mechanistically linked to the CAR-T product, but that product is an excluded intervention type and not a candidate, hence candidate_matched false.
